description: The dashboard's stable per-project port (generated once by scripts/dashboard-port.sh ensure, port = PP*1000+NNN, PP 50..64, so browser state tied to the dashboard origin survives restarts) and the optional glyph and colour settings of the terminal progress renderers.

keys.label: Dashboard port
keys.description: TCP port the dashboard prefers for this project (50000-64999). Generated per project by scripts/dashboard-port.sh ensure; change it here only to pick a different fixed port.

keys.label: Progress charset
keys.description: Glyph set of the terminal progress renderers (lib/progress): utf8 draws the design glyphs, ascii draws a pure-ASCII twin. Never guessed from LANG or LC_*. Precedence: --charset flag, then JENGA_PROGRESS_CHARSET, then this key, then utf8. Optional: a project that lacks the key uses utf8.

keys.label: Progress colour
keys.description: Colour of the terminal progress renderers (lib/progress): auto is on only for a terminal with NO_COLOR unset or empty, always forces ANSI colour, never turns it off. Precedence: --color flag, then JENGA_PROGRESS_COLOR, then this key, then auto. Optional: a project that lacks the key uses auto.
